title: How Do Game Characters Know Where to Go? 🎮 #GTA6 #shorts
description:
Open-world games like GTA fill their streets with cars and people. So how does each one know where to go? The game gives them a hidden map: roads become a network of points and lines, and walkable areas become a navigation mesh. A pathfinding algorithm, often A*, then searches for the best route, scoring each step by the distance travelled so far plus an estimate of what's left, so it explores the most promising paths first. Games spread that work across many frames, and for crowds, simple flocking rules do the rest: keep your distance, match your neighbours' direction, stay with the group.

This explains how game AI generally works, not the internals of any specific game.
